Decimal.description:
A fixed-point decimal value with 18 fractional digits, i.e. Decimal(1_000_000_000_000_000_000) == 1.0

The greatest possible value that can be represented is 340282366920938463463.374607431768211455 (which is (2^128 - 1) / 10^18)

Addr.description:
A human readable address.

In Cosmos, this is typically bech32 encoded. But for multi-chain smart contracts no assumptions should be made other than being UTF-8 encoded and of reasonable length.

This type represents a validated address. It can be created in the following ways 1. Use `Addr::unchecked(input)` 2. Use `let checked: Addr = deps.api.addr_validate(input)?` 3. Use `let checked: Addr = deps.api.addr_humanize(canonical_addr)?` 4. Deserialize from JSON. This must only be done from JSON that was validated before such as a contract's state. `Addr` must not be used in messages sent by the user because this would result in unvalidated instances.

This type is immutable. If you really need to mutate it (Really? Are you sure?), create a mutable copy using `let mut mutable = Addr::to_string()` and operate on that `String` instance.

Binary.description:
Binary is a wrapper around Vec<u8> to add base64 de/serialization with serde. It also adds some helper methods to help encode inline.

This is only needed as serde-json-{core,wasm} has a horrible encoding for Vec<u8>. See also <https://github.com/CosmWasm/cosmwasm/blob/main/docs/MESSAGE_TYPES.md>.

query_available_to_borrow.title: Uint128

accumulated_rewards.description: used to match all loans by creation date

bgl_supply.description: increased on try_deposit                                                                    \ decreased on try_withdraw

borrowed.description: increased on try_borrow if regular.deposited - regular.unbonded - regular.borrowed > 0      \ decreased on try_repay, try_liquidate if reserve.borrowed == 0

deposited.description: increased on try_deposit                                                                    \ decreased on try_withdraw

main_pool.description: used to determine bgl price and deposit apr                                                 \ increased on try_deposit - full; try_repay, try_liquidate - rewards                         \ decreased on try_withdraw

unbonded.description: increased on try_unbond                                                                     \ decreased on try_withdraw

borrowed.description: used to provide temporary liquidity to borrowers w/o affecting on bgl price and deposit apr        \ accumulated rewards goes to regular part as reserve liquidity provider can't earn           \ increased on try_borrow if regular.deposited - regular.unbonded - regular.borrowed == 0     \ decreased on try_repay, try_liquidate if reserve.borrowed > 0

deposited.description: increased on try_deposit_reserve_liquidity                                                  \ decreased on try_withdraw_reserve_liquidity

withdrawn.description: used to provide temporary liquidity to withdrawers w/o affecting on bgl price and deposit apr        \ has higher priority than reserve.borrowed                                                    \ increased on try_withdraw if withdrawal_amount > regular.main_pool                           \ decreased on try_repay, try_liquidate if reserve.withdrawn > 0
